body.text: Just started using Orion and the WinAPI-style message loop makes everything so familiar. Highly recommended for desktop apps.

comment.text: Totally agree, the form_def_t API is very clean.

reply.text: Thanks! Took a while to get the DDX bindings right.
Same experience here, love the DDX approach.
Yes, set UI_WINDOW_SCALE=2 in your build.

comment.text: I migrated from FLTK and this feels much more natural.

body.text: You can write a fully custom control by implementing just evCreate, evPaint, evLeftButtonDown and evDestroy. The framework handles the rest through the message loop.

comment.text: Great tip! I used this for a colour picker widget.

reply.text: Show us the colour picker! Sounds useful.

body.text: Use WINDOW_VSCROLL on the content window, call set_scroll_info() in evCreate, and handle evVScroll to update your pan offset. No extra child scrollbar windows needed.

comment.text: This tripped me up for days - glad you posted it!

reply.text: The exact same pattern applies to WINDOW_HSCROLL.

comment.text: Does this work the same for WINDOW_HSCROLL?

reply.text: Yes - handle evHScroll identically, just change SB_HORZ to SB_VERT.

body.text: RVM_ADDCOLUMN + RVM_ADDITEM to build the list, RVM_SETREDRAW(0) before bulk inserts and (1) after. Use RVM_SETREPORTCOLUMNWIDTH(0, ...) for the auto-stretch column.

comment.text: The RVM_SETREDRAW trick alone saved me huge repaint jank - thanks!

reply.text: Glad it helps - that one is documented in columnview.h.

comment.text: How do you handle double-click selection?

reply.text: Listen for RVN_DBLCLK in evCommand - LOWORD(wparam) is the row index.

comment.text: Any way to get multi-column sorting?

reply.text: Not built-in yet - you'd need to sort the data array and call feed_refresh().

body.text: Declare children in a static form_ctrl_def_t[] array, add a ctrl_binding_t[] for data exchange, then call show_dialog_from_form(). No imperative child creation needed - everything is declarative.

comment.text: The edGetText binding style for multiline edits is especially handy.
Is there a way to add validation before the dialog closes?

reply.text: Yes - handle evCommand/btnClicked for ID_OK, run validation, and only call end_dialog() when it passes.
Perfect, that's exactly what I needed. Thanks!
